# Real-Time Notes row icons

These unmodified ICO files and generated `icons.h` bytes come from Git object `89d26e5^`, path `legacy/RealTimeNotesDeskband/references/genshin-real-time-notes-0.0.8/embedded/assets/`. The upstream bundled license is reproduced in LICENSE (MIT, copyright 2024 Steven Culwell). No network download or account data was used. The original game artwork and names retain their respective owners.

`icons.h` embeds exact ICO bytes so installed DesktopStub builds do not depend on a donor executable or loose asset directory. Native rendering uses the supported Windows ICO decoder and exports immutable versioned PNGs into package Assets when needed. Missing/undecodable icons fall back to the existing resource glyph or text with no blank column.
